openingMessage: Responsibility is the path to meaning.
openingWhy: Ask a twenty-year hand why he's still out here — it's never the per diem. It's being the man a crew bets their lives on, and having earned that bet every single day. That weight isn't the cost of this job. It's the pay.
leadershipThought: Breaking containment is where small mistakes turn into big consequences. Preparation, awareness, and discipline to stop work keep people safe.
